company_name: SPT- Small Precision Tools Co.,  Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — SPT specializes in wire and die bonding tools essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: SPT-Small Precision Tools Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of semiconductor wire and die bonding tools, offering a comprehensive range of products including capillaries for copper and gold wire bonding, ultrasonic wedges, and specialized bonding tools. Their innovations, such as the emPower capillary, address the increasing demands of power semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Capillaries for copper and gold wire bonding
Ultrasonic wedges for aluminum and gold wire bonding
Die attach collets for various bonding applications
